class.name: SteamStatsEdit
class.brief_description: A branchable draft of changes to the signed-in player's Steam stats and achievements.
class.description: Create a draft with [method SteamStats.edit]. Each modifier returns an independent branch. Only [method submit] applies edits, in the order they were added. Keep the owning [SteamStats] scope active until submission.

method.name: set_float
method.description: Returns a branch that sets the published float stat to an absolute value. The value must be finite and fit Steam's single-precision range.

method.name: set_int
method.description: Returns a branch that sets the published integer stat to an absolute value in the signed 32-bit range.

method.name: submit
method.description: Validates the draft before applying any edits. If a Steam setter rejects an edit after preflight, earlier accepted edits remain in the local cache. Once every edit succeeds, submits one persistence request. The result includes edit counts for every outcome. Observe [signal SteamStats.stats_stored] for the app-wide backend response.

method.name: unlock
method.description: Returns a branch that unlocks the published achievement when the draft is submitted.

method.name: update_average_rate
method.description: Returns a branch that adds a finite accumulated count over a finite positive duration in seconds. Steam checks whether the named stat accepts average-rate updates when the draft is applied.
